scaleRange.policy: cover using existing viewport; preserve reference composition

roles.purpose: 메인과 같은 성운·궤도 우주 배경 — 설정·인증·보조 화면

scaleRange.policy: cover using existing viewport; preserve reference composition

roles.placement: full scene behind existing UI
roles.doNotUse: Do not recolor, bake UI text, or put bright edge detail under small text.

roles.name: dust-tile
roles.placement: tile repeat XY; use screen-specific opacity budget
roles.doNotUse: Do not display at full opacity, enlarge particles, or use snow-like uniform vertical drift.

roles.name: sparkle-small
roles.placement: peripheral accents
roles.doNotUse: 8px markers cannot encode progression states.

roles.name: sparkle-cross
roles.placement: near a focal object
roles.doNotUse: Do not use at8px or scatter many at equal brightness.

roles.name: sparkle-pearl
roles.placement: quiet depth layer
roles.doNotUse: Do not tint, use on white, or enlarge into a bokeh disc.

roles.name: sparkle-shard
roles.placement: sparse outer field
roles.doNotUse: Do not render as a jewel or use a dense shower.

roles.name: sparkle-needle
roles.placement: one accent at a time
roles.doNotUse: Do not use at8px;16px is weak; never make a long attack slash.

roles.name: twinkle-small
roles.placement: phases offset across sparse positions
roles.doNotUse: Do not synchronize all particles or scale the whole256px cell as if it were128px.

roles.name: twinkle-cross
roles.placement: rare local accent
roles.doNotUse: Do not fill the whole scene with simultaneous peaks.

roles.name: pearl-pulse
roles.placement: away from text baselines
roles.doNotUse: Do not tint or enlarge beyond a small mote.

roles.name: dust-drift
roles.purpose: 실제 점 위치 이동과 fade loop
roles.placement: one or two512px patches; fixed phase offset
roles.doNotUse: Do not reuse as dense gameplay fog.

roles.name: node-idle
roles.placement: existing song row or actual relation node
roles.doNotUse: Do not infer new progression rules; use source128px sizing, never padded-cell width as source sizing.

roles.name: node-hover
roles.placement: existing song row or actual relation node
roles.doNotUse: Do not infer new progression rules; use source128px sizing, never padded-cell width as source sizing.

roles.name: node-selected
roles.placement: existing song row or actual relation node
roles.doNotUse: Do not infer new progression rules; use source128px sizing, never padded-cell width as source sizing.

roles.name: node-cleared
roles.placement: existing song row or actual relation node
roles.doNotUse: Do not infer new progression rules; use source128px sizing, never padded-cell width as source sizing.

roles.name: node-completed
roles.purpose: 기존 완료 상태의 큰 pearl 핵
roles.placement: existing song row or actual relation node
roles.doNotUse: Do not infer new progression rules; use source128px sizing, never padded-cell width as source sizing.

roles.name: line-dim
roles.placement: anchor at left end, rotate toward actual relation end; keep1–3px body
roles.doNotUse: Do not draw a fabricated progress graph or uniformly shrink the line height.

roles.name: line-active
roles.placement: anchor at left end, rotate toward actual relation end; keep1–3px body
roles.doNotUse: Do not draw a fabricated progress graph or uniformly shrink the line height.

roles.name: line-complete
roles.placement: anchor at left end, rotate toward actual relation end; keep1–3px body
roles.doNotUse: Do not draw a fabricated progress graph or uniformly shrink the line height.

roles.name: connection-pulse
roles.purpose: 실제 관계를 따라 움직이는 작은 빛
roles.placement: same endpoints and angle as the associated line
roles.doNotUse: Do not use without an actual relation or loop forever.

roles.name: constellation-reveal
roles.frameCountNote: No new frame images; plays the explicitly referenced real clips.
roles.purpose: node 점등 → 실제 관계의 선 공개 → 국소 보상
roles.placement: actual current song and eligible relation only
roles.doNotUse: If no existing relation, use node-only-reveal; do not fabricate a graph or progression rules.

roles.name: logo-glint
roles.placement: at logo lower-right margin once on entry; leave current letter pixels in code
roles.doNotUse: Do not rasterize the logo or continuously sweep over menu text.

roles.name: title-star-thread
roles.placement: quiet gap below logo and above menu
roles.doNotUse: Decorative only; do not treat this motif as progression data.

roles.name: foreground-motes
roles.placement: one640px patch near lower-right foreground
roles.doNotUse: Do not enlarge into bokeh or place over menus.

roles.name: jacket-glint
roles.purpose: 선택 재킷 모서리의 한 번 반짝임
roles.placement: selected jacket corner after focus changes
roles.doNotUse: Do not draw a glowing card border.

roles.name: selected-halo
roles.purpose: 선택 핵 주변의 열린 두 arc
roles.placement: centered on selected node, not around entire jacket
roles.doNotUse: Do not use below32px source canvas, rotate as a spinner, or close the ring.

roles.name: orbit-arc
roles.placement: offset beside selected jacket; never across title text
roles.doNotUse: Do not use below128px or turn into a circular mechanical menu.

roles.name: navigation-star
roles.placement: before selected navigation label
roles.doNotUse: Do not use as a pointer hit target.

roles.name: note-glint
roles.placement: bound to existing note display event
roles.doNotUse: Do not shift note timing, input, judgement or visual note shape.

roles.name: note-trail
roles.placement: anchor generated bright head to existing note, behind the note
roles.doNotUse: Do not extend onto score/judgement text; one active trail per lane.

roles.name: hit-flare
roles.purpose: 판정 지점의 짧은 세 갈래 core
roles.placement: align measured core with existing lane judgement line
roles.doNotUse: Do not center by whole-cell bbox or stack old flares in one lane.

roles.name: hit-sparkle
roles.placement: existing hit location, inside one lane
roles.doNotUse: Do not add random unbounded sparks or keep alive beyond clip.

roles.name: perfect-burst
roles.placement: one local fan per lane on an existing PERFECT event
roles.doNotUse: Do not invent a new judgement threshold or cover judgement lettering.

roles.name: combo-glint
roles.purpose: 기존 combo 강조 사건의 짧은 이동 빛
roles.placement: beside combo display; reuse existing milestone events only
roles.doNotUse: If no existing milestone event exists, do not add a new threshold.

roles.name: judgement-shimmer
roles.placement: below or beside existing judgement text
roles.doNotUse: Do not bake text or cover its glyph interiors.

roles.name: rank-burst
roles.purpose: 빈 중심을 둔 다섯 별의 완료 보상
roles.placement: around rank with central opening aligned to empty surrounding space
roles.doNotUse: Do not cover rank glyph or turn into full-screen fireworks.

roles.name: score-shimmer
roles.placement: just below score baseline, after value is settled
roles.doNotUse: Do not delay or mask the real score.

roles.name: jacket-starfall
roles.placement: outside jacket edge, within256px local area
roles.doNotUse: Do not rain over the entire result or overlay bright silver leaves at screen edge.

roles.name: clear-bloom
roles.purpose: 해당 별 주변의 국소 점등 보상
roles.placement: center on just-cleared/completed song node
roles.doNotUse: Do not use a full-screen bloom, new score rule or success state.

roles.name: constellation-finish
roles.frameCountNote: No new frame images; plays the explicitly referenced real clips.
roles.purpose: node 점등 → 실제 관계의 선 공개 → 국소 보상 및 rank·score·jacket 마감
roles.placement: actual current song and eligible relation only
roles.doNotUse: If no existing relation, use node-only-reveal; do not fabricate a graph or progression rules.

roles.name: star-thread
roles.placement: one local transition gesture near the next focal area
roles.doNotUse: Do not stretch to screen-filling neon or block navigation.

roles.name: shimmer-wipe
roles.placement: local edge sweep accompanying the existing scene change
roles.doNotUse: This is a light accent, not an opaque full-screen mask.

roles.name: dust-dissolve
roles.placement: one512px patch synchronized with existing crossfade
roles.doNotUse: Do not treat it as a black/white screen cover or raise ambient density.

roles.name: loading-star
roles.placement: beside existing loading text/status
roles.doNotUse: Do not spin, falsely show completion, or hold actual navigation.

roles.name: divider-glint
roles.placement: existing divider endpoint
roles.doNotUse: Do not make every divider equally bright.

roles.name: focus-star
roles.placement: beside focused item using existing focus state
roles.doNotUse: Decorative/pointer-events disabled; do not replace focus semantics.

roles.name: grain
roles.placement: repeat XY on night base, behind all readable UI
roles.doNotUse: Do not use as the celestial particle system; no grain layer over gameplay video.

additionalSemanticState.meaning: existing played flag only, distinguish from existing cleared state
additionalSemanticState.doNotUse: Do not invent play history or display semantic state at8px.
